unstarted.title: pdocs work board
unstarted.description: A live dashboard an agent opens to show where project-docs work stands, what needs triage and what is active, with a skill and a small app behind it.

unstarted.title: Build the work board's server and pdocs bridge
unstarted.description: A daemon an agent can open, query and stop, which reads a project only through its own pdocs CLI, refuses a CLI too old to serve it, and accepts exactly two kinds of write.

unstarted.title: Build the work board's shell and five pages, read-only
unstarted.description: The layout D shell over live data, with the Now, Inbox, Triage, Cycle and Feature pages drawn, polled and navigable by keyboard, before any write.

unstarted.title: Stop view entries unquoting title and the older fields twice
unstarted.description: A title or other older entry field that begins and ends with a quoted phrase loses its outer quotes, because scalar unquotes a value the parser already unquoted.

started.title: Build the work board's model and selection rules
started.description: Layout D's behaviour as pure, tested functions over a snapshot: grouping, the Inbox rows, candidates, blockers, snooze and the selection rules.

completed.title: pdocs new writes a catalog line Prettier reformats
completed.description: The index.md line pdocs new writes for a library page is not Prettier-stable, so the first commit fails a format check.

completed.title: A work board for project-docs: what we have, the landscape, and what to build
completed.description: Inventory our document types and states, survey how other tools visualize the same things, and recommend what a project-docs work board includes and leaves out.

completed.title: Carry the board's fields on pdocs view entries
completed.description: pdocs view JSON gains description, from and source on every entry, and appetite and started on a cycle entry, so a caller outside the repository needs nothing else.

advisories.message: 91 finished items are not archived, over the threshold of 25 (checks.archive.threshold). Consider archiving them to shorten this view. Archiving preserves their records and updates links.
advisories.action: Offer the user a concrete selection, then run `pdocs archive <ref>` for each one they agree to; `--format json` lists the candidates. Nothing is archived automatically.

types.remediation: Choose which of the 91 finished items to archive, confirm that selection with the user, then run `pdocs archive item/<slug>` for each.

advisories.message: 5 items in the active cycle have no reviewed document (`status: stable`): item/board-server-and-pdocs-bridge (draft, ready in active cycle 2026-11-work-board), item/board-shell-and-five-pages (draft, backlog in active cycle 2026-11-work-board), item/board-two-writes-with-undo (draft, backlog in active cycle 2026-11-work-board), item/repin-migration-for-board-fields (draft, backlog in active cycle 2026-11-work-board) and item/work-board-skill-and-packaging (draft, backlog in active cycle 2026-11-work-board).
advisories.action: Show the user each item's description and definition of done; once they approve that content (approval already given in this conversation counts), run `pdocs set item/<slug> --status stable`, on its own or in the same command as the start. Never set it without that review.

cycles.title: The work board
cycles.description: Build the pdocs work board at its in-between level, and keep a feature's finished items in view until the feature is done.
cycles.appetite: Stop when the board opens on this repository's own docs with its five pages, makes its two writes through pdocs set, and #210 has landed.
